lines.text: I came without eloquence or wisdom and resolved to know nothing except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
I came in weakness and fear, with the Spirit's power, so faith would rest on God's power.
We speak God's hidden wisdom, destined for our glory, which this age's rulers did not understand.
God revealed it to us through the prophets, and only the Spirit of God knows God's thoughts.
We received the Spirit from God, not the spirit of slavery, and we have the mind of Christ.
